chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Abī Bishr, from Ḥammād ibn Abī Ṭalḥah, who said:

Zurārah ibn Aʿyan narrated to me, saying: I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: Two men pray within one time, and one of them performs the ʿaṣr prayer early while the other delays the ẓuhr prayer. He said: There is no harm.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.يُصَلِّيَانِ: the two men are performing salat

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for one person to pray ʿaṣr early while another delays ẓuhr within the same time period?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the legal permissibility of variation within the shared time of ẓuhr and ʿaṣr prayers. Imam Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام rules that there is no problem if one person hastens ʿaṣr while another delays ẓuhr, indicating flexibility within the valid prayer time.
